phase_title: Docker Runtime Enablement, Containerized Gate C Closure & Conditional 100% Staging Shadow Promotion

staging_net.name: tradingagents-p125-staging_net
staging_net.notes: Primary staging network for inter-service communication

postgres_data.name: tradingagents-p125-staging_postgres_data
postgres_data.notes: Dedicated named volume for staging postgres data; isolated from production

redis.notes: Redis has no host port binding; accessible only within staging network

host_binding_notes: All host port bindings use 127.0.0.1 (loopback only); no 0.0.0.0 bindings; no external network exposure

db_isolation.method: dedicated postgres:16-alpine container with named volume tradingagents-p125-staging_postgres_data
db_isolation.notes: Staging DB is fully isolated from any production database; uses separate named volume

redis_isolation.notes: Redis is on staging network only; no host port exposed

fixes_applied.detail: staging-internal explicit Docker network name changed from 'tradingagents-p125-staging_internal' to 'tradingagents-p125-staging_net' to avoid collision with the internal network of the same composed name
PI_CANARY_MAX_ROLLOUT_PERCENT=100 added to .env.staging.local; default value was 5.0 which would have blocked rollout_percent=75 from taking effect
PI_CANARY_AUTHORIZATION_STATUS changed from invalid value 'authorized' to valid enum value 'approved'; 'authorized' is not a recognized value in the CanaryAuthorizationStatus enum

redacted_notes: All credential and secret values are stored in .env.staging.local which is gitignored; no secrets appear in this artifact
